d:
Mokama ke vidhayak Anant Singh ne sarendar se pahle apne siyasi bhavishy ko lekar bara bayan diya hai. unhonne kaha, main lokasbha larunga.' unke is bayan ke bad bihar ki rajniti men unke parivar ki agli rajnitik pari ko lekar charcha tej ho gaee hai.
Dularchand Yadav hatyakand men suprim kort se jamanat radd hone ke bad Anant Singh ko 1 disanbar tak sarendar karna hai. beti ki shadi ke bad ab unke is bayan ne ek bar phir sabka dhyan khincha hai. aakhir bete ko vidhanasbha aur khud lokasbha chunav larane ke pichhe Anant Singh ki kya yojna hai?
